text_block_list.name: Light Hearted Umas
text_block_list.text:
— So then the instructor said～ — For 
real? That's no joke.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—— T-They've finished eating and it is 
lunch time right now… I should… call out 
to them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
…Alright! Just thinking about it won't do 
any good. If I admire heroes, then I need 
to be a little brave…!

text_block_list.name: Light Hearted Umas
text_block_list.text:
— You do the homework? — Nah～ Not feeling 
like using so much brain today～

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uuu. B-But… how do I approach them…

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—— If you two have finished eating, then 
clear out.

text_block_list.name: Light Hearted Uma
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah! Sorry! We were just leaving～!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: W-Wow…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Yuni! Hello, I was just about to go to 
your room and get you ——

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
— Damn it! Tran! Don't mess with me! That 
bag of candy was mineeeee!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rob Roy! Wanna join in? It's an 
intense game with treasure on the line!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Observation". It looks "fun" and "prizes" 
are involved. Should we "CLNG"?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It does, doesn't it. However… I never 
played this game before ——

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Aruvu! Come play! Your fellow 
classmates are playing too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm good.

text_block_list.name: Group mate Uma
text_block_list.text:
H-Having a joint cooking lesson for the 
2nd years is quite troublesome, isn't it. 
Who's making what…?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. Um… H-How are we going to decide?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will make the main course. The rest of 
you will make the sides. Decide who makes 
what yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hah… What should I do to be like her…

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
? "Theory". Zenno Rob Roy, is something 
"bothering" you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-There is. The thing is…

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —— Hey. Don't block the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wah, S-Still!? I'm sorry, I'll move right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Aruvu, could you please teach me… well… 
You know, I've always been ——

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …Huh!? S-She's not here…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—— Ah, Aruvu! Hah, hah… P-Please wait a 
second!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, thank you for earlier! …And the 
thing is, well, um ——

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What can I do to act dignified like you… 
is that possible!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Whenever I'm in front of a crowd, I lose 
all my confidence… so that's why ——

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —— I have no interest.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If it isn't important, I have no interest. 
…Who cares what people see or think.

I was walking in the hallway to convey 
something to <chrname> when…

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I see. Aruvu did something like that. But… 
I think she's a little mysterious.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Well… I feel like she notices things about 
me before anyone else does… Someone who 
really pays attention to her surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Q". Admire Groove has "no interest in her 
surroundings". But she's "good at noticing 
things"?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-She certainly is a little mysterious, 
isn't she. …Although next time, I wonder 
if I'd be able to talk to her.
